description: This file implements the DatabaseConnection class, providing methods for connecting, disconnecting, executing queries, and retrieving results from a database within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages database connection lifecycle and query execution within the plugin.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the number of affected rows.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the result set.

methods.name: DbCallbackOnly
methods.description: Callback for executing queries that do not return results.

methods.name: DbCallbackGetResults
methods.description: Callback for retrieving query results into a DatabaseTable.
